factors.name: Supply/Demand zones: fresh strong zone + confirmation, with the trend
factors.call: zn.dz_since <= 2 and zn.dz_tests <= 2 and zn.dz_move >= 1.2 and zn.room_up >= 1.5 and green and body > 0.5 * range and close > high[1] and close > zn.dz_hi and low >= zn.dz_lo
factors.put: zn.sz_since <= 2 and zn.sz_tests <= 2 and zn.sz_move >= 1.2 and zn.room_dn >= 1.5 and red and body < -0.5 * range and close < low[1] and close < zn.sz_lo and high <= zn.sz_hi
